a: Push reaches outside the app; in-app notifies while the user is active.
Let users choose channels and categories; default conservatively.
Fan-out writes notification records to many recipients efficiently.
Collapse duplicate events so users are not spammed.
Respect quiet hours and timezones for non-urgent messages.
Batch low-priority updates into digests instead of many singles.
FCM (Android) and APNs (iOS) deliver mobile push notifications.
Web Push uses service workers and VAPID keys for browser notifications.
Templates keep copy consistent and localizable.
Badges show unread counts; keep them accurate to avoid distrust.
